title: Treated improvement matched by placebo control arm
what: net treatment advantage over placebo (~0.6 pts or ~1.0 pp), inside 95% CI noise

reader_questions.question: What is the primary quantitative finding or value?
reader_questions.expected: Net effect over placebo is only +0.6 pts (+1.0 pp): treated improves 15.0% while placebo improves 14.0%.

reader_questions.question: Is the difference clearly outside uncertainty or noise?
reader_questions.expected: No; the treated and placebo trajectories and 95% CIs overlap throughout all 8 weeks.

reader_questions.question: What caveat, outlier, control, or subgroup pattern matters?
reader_questions.expected: Looking at treated.csv alone falsely suggests a ~15% drug effect that is almost entirely placebo/time response.
